publicEntrypoints.name: moon-relay-kernel
publicEntrypoints.purpose: Kernel control plane entrypoint for adaptive risk-bound workflow.

kernel-minimal-correct-change.guidance: Keep the change minimal and contract-shaped.

kernel-tracer-slicing.guidance: Trace and slice complex work before execution.

kernel-test-driven-development.guidance: Use a failing test and a focused green implementation.

kernel-diagnosing-bugs.guidance: Diagnose the failure boundary before changing behavior.

kernel-review-spec.guidance: Review the public contract and acceptance semantics.

kernel-review-standards.guidance: Review implementation against applicable engineering standards.

kernel-review-complexity.guidance: Review complexity and dependency surface after functional review.

kernel-commit-closeout.guidance: Run explicit approved Git closeout after knowledge commit.

kernel-verification-before-completion.condition: route includes EXECUTE or explicit completion attempt
kernel-verification-before-completion.guidance: Require fresh, scope-matched evidence before completion.

kernel-requirements-analysis.condition: acceptance unverifiable, objective/non-goal conflict, or outcome-changing ambiguity
kernel-requirements-analysis.guidance: Clarify only the contract details that change a verifiable outcome.

kernel-conditional-design.condition: architecture boundary, public contract, migration, or irreversible decision
kernel-conditional-design.guidance: Record a short design judgment only when the decision changes the implementation boundary.

kernel-conditional-planning.condition: multiple independent deliverables, long-lived resume, or safe parallel split
kernel-conditional-planning.guidance: Use contract steps only when each slice has independent scope and verification.

kernel-focused-test-guidance.condition: behavior change with an appropriate test surface
kernel-focused-test-guidance.guidance: Prefer a focused regression test when the project exposes a suitable test seam.

kernel-systematic-debugging.condition: repeated verification failure, repeated blocker, or unclear root cause
kernel-systematic-debugging.guidance: On repeated failure, analyze the cause boundary before applying another patch.

kernel-conditional-frontend-guidance.condition: frontend source mutation, UI redesign, or visual behavior change
kernel-conditional-frontend-guidance.guidance: Preserve design context, tokens, responsive behavior, accessibility, and state design.

kernel-security-review-policy.condition: authentication, untrusted input, dependency, security API, or high-risk data boundary
kernel-security-review-policy.guidance: Require project security verification and Kernel-recorded independent Review Receipt.

kernel-simplification-check.condition: non-trivial behavior-changing implementation where preservation can be checked
kernel-simplification-check.guidance: Check for unnecessary abstraction, duplication, scope expansion, and speculative configuration.

kernel-browser-proof-adapter.condition: browser behavior is explicit, required, or necessary to judge completion
kernel-browser-proof-adapter.guidance: Use the Kernel browser proof adapter only when the contract requires browser behavior; enforce evidence depth.
